name: coral-skills
description: Build and operate Coral agent systems inside real applications

interface.shortDescription: Build Coral agent systems for your application.
interface.longDescription: Turn application requirements into Coral agents, open communication graphs, Puppet or API ingress, custom-tool callbacks, session lifecycle code, and observable runtime proof. Also covers Server, Cloud, marketplace agents, schemas, and debugging.
defaultPrompt: Build a working Coral agent system for this application.
Turn these roles and tools into a Coral graph and test it.
Wire this app to Coral and show the live agent threads.
